# sung

> Music data access


## Pages in this subsection

- [sung](sung.html.md): Tools to get music metadata (from Spotify, Wikipedia, etc.)
- [sung.base](sung.base.html.md): Base functionalities for the sung package.
- [sung.chords_and_lyrics](sung.chords_and_lyrics.html.md): Tools for chords and lyrics acquisition and processing.
- [sung.chords_index](sung.chords_index.html.md): A SQLite + FTS5 index of the chords-and-lyrics corpus, read without the corpus in memory.
- [sung.playlists](sung.playlists.html.md): Build Spotify playlists from human-friendly song descriptors.
- [sung.pydantic_models](sung.pydantic_models.html.md): Pydantic models generated by datamodel-codegen using the Spotify API OpenAPI spec.
- [sung.tools](sung.tools.html.md): Tools using sung
- [sung.util](sung.util.html.md): Utility functions for the sung package.

## Optional

- [Top-level llms.txt](../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
